Name: ConfigureSystemGuardLaunch
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Enables System Guard Secure Launch (DRTM) to protect boot from firmware attacks.
Security Impact: Without DRTM, firmware attacks can compromise the security chain before OS loads.
Change Risk Level: Low - Enables hardware-based root of trust (DRTM); no application compatibility impact

Name: EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Enables Virtualization Based Security (VBS) to isolate critical OS components.
Security Impact: Disabling VBS removes memory isolation for credentials and code integrity.
Change Risk Level: Low - Enables Virtualization Based Security; foundational for Credential Guard and HVCI with minimal operational risk

Name: HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Enables Hypervisor-protected Code Integrity (HVCI) for kernel-mode code signing.
Security Impact: Disabling HVCI allows unsigned kernel drivers, increasing rootkit exposure.
Change Risk Level: Low - Enforces kernel-mode code integrity via hypervisor; may block unsigned/incompatible drivers
